title: Complaints against "finfluencers" who Dispense Financial Advice Online
what_it_is: Complaints against "finfluencers" who Dispense Financial Advice Online

sections.label: MAS rules for finfluencers
sections.summary: MAS expects financial institutions using finfluencers to ensure clear, balanced information, and finfluencers giving financial advice must be licensed under the FAA.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) expects financial institutions who employ finfluencers to advertise their products or services, to ensure that the finfluencers present information in a clear and balanced format that highlights key features and risks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: If finfluencers provide financial advice, they must be licensed and regulated under the Financial Advisers Act, or FAA.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: MAS has issued guidelines to clarify that any individual who is remunerated for making a recommendation or expressing an opinion on the buying, selling or holding of investment products will be considered as providing financial advice.

sections.label: Complaints and enforcement against finfluencers
sections.summary: MAS received under five finfluencer complaints yearly, and enforcement action was taken against six individuals over three years, none finfluencers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Over the past five years, MAS received an average of less than five complaints per year against finfluencers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: MAS and the Commercial Affairs Department will take enforcement action against individuals providing financial advice without a licence.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Over the past three years, enforcement action has been taken against six individuals, none of whom were finfluencers.

sections.label: Finfluencers must be appointed representatives
sections.summary: A finfluencer providing financial advice must be appointed as a representative of a financial advisory firm regulated under the FAA.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: As I mentioned earlier on, only financial advisory firms and their representatives who are regulated under the FAA are allowed to provide financial advisory services on investment products.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Therefore, a finfluencer who provides financial advice will have to be appointed as a representative of a financial advisory firm.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: That said, we regularly advise the public to only deal with and invest through persons regulated by the MAS.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: We also list unregulated persons who may have been wrongly perceived as being licensed or authorised by MAS on our Investor Alert List.
